reglas.title: Rules
reglas.intro: Read this before you commit an offside on your picks. No fine print — just what you need to play smoothly.
reglas.picaditoBody: <brand>timbafulbo</brand> is a free, fan-made prediction pool. It's not a betting site or a corporate product: it's a grassroots project to run leagues with your crew and see who really knows football when the whistle blows.
reglas.howToPlayBody1: Create a tournament (your league), invite friends with a link, and before each match enter your prediction: winner and score. When the match ends, points go to those who got the result and those who nailed the exact score.
reglas.howToPlayBody2: How much each hit is worth can vary by tournament — the league creator sets that. No VAR to reinterpret the rules after the match.
reglas.tournamentsBody1: Right now we only run the <tournament></tournament>. Match and team data comes from the free <apiLink>football-data.org</apiLink> API, and the project is free to use and maintain — no budget for premium data plans.
reglas.tournamentsBody2: So there is <notYet></notYet> Argentine league, Libertadores, Champions or other competitions outside that API. If we get funding or find alternatives, we might add more. For now, World Cup only.
reglas.fairPlayBetting: No real-money betting — it's a friends' pool, not a casino.
reglas.fairPlayLock: Predictions close {minutes} minutes before kickoff; no edits after that.
reglas.bugsBody1: This is a <personal></personal>, <openSource></openSource> project. If something breaks, a match looks wrong, or you want a feature (another tournament, better UI, whatever), message the creator or open a GitHub issue. PRs welcome.
reglas.disclaimerBody: There may be downtime, late API data, or changes without notice. Thanks for rolling with it.
